title: Unit 11 Consolidation: Human Rights, Minority Protections & International Law
goal: I can say that rights cannot be taken away and cannot be limited.
I can talk about minority rights, war crimes and treaties in Hungarian law.
I can report what a text says about guilt and responsibility.
